genext2fs

genext2fs generates ext2 filesystem images without mounting them or requiring superuser privileges. This maintained branch supplies the library interface used by Abuild.

Documentation

  • genext2fs(8) manual page
  • Authoritative upstream repository
  • Abuild

Repository branches

master
Mirror of the authoritative upstream history.
abuild
Maintained source branch consumed by Abuild.
abuild-gh
GitHub CI and documentation overlay.
